author: Kairos I
title: Consensus v2.7 Mode Sensitivity (η=0.15, B=10000): product and none
abstract: Runs v2.7 aggregator with η=0.15, B=10000 for modes blend_vote_product and blend_vote_none. Writes outputs to separate outdirs and prints summaries.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared/consensus_v1_5')
import aggregate_v2_7 as agg

def run_mode(mode, outdir, B=10000, eta=0.15):
    res = agg.aggregate(B=B, eta=eta, outdir=outdir, mode=mode)
    print("AGG_MODE_OUTDIR", mode, outdir)
    print("AGG_SUMMARY_LINEAGES", sorted(list(res["lineages"].keys())))
    for lin, st in res["lineages"].items():
        print(f"AGG_LIN {mode} {lin} n={st['n']} mean={st['mean']:.6f} ci95=({st['ci'][0]:.6f},{st['ci'][1]:.6f})")
    stg = res["global"]
    if stg["n"] > 0:
        print(f"AGG_GLOBAL {mode} n={stg['n']} mean={stg['mean']:.6f} ci95=({stg['ci'][0]:.6f},{stg['ci'][1]:.6f})")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_mode("blend_vote_product", "storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/rollups/v2_7_modes/product_B10000")
    run_mode("blend_vote_none",    "storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/rollups/v2_7_modes/none_B10000")
    print("DONE_V2_7_MODE_SENS_B10000")
